# Apps publishes Finance and Email, retires RealWorld, and updates Web Desktop

## Context

`#21140` (Cornerstone 1 of Engine 14, `ROADMAP.md`, cut Mon 23 Nov) targets a verified, covered, responsive showcase across every group of the examples section by Fri 20 Nov `12:00 CET`. Following [the Apps slate audit on `#21142`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21142#issuecomment-6981046662) (`dev` `0128668721`, 16 entries opened and used at `1440 × 900` and `390 × 844`), `Apps` moves from `4` to `6` home cards (`✓` keeps: `webdesktop`, `devindex`, `covid-dashboard`, `portal`; `↻` renews + adds records: `finance`, `email`; `✕` retires: `realworld`, `realworld-v2`) under the one-batch-PR-per-group rule (`#21140` Build notes).

## The Problem

- **`apps/finance` is missing from `examples.json` and wastes `40%` of the desktop stage:** six fixed-width columns (`40+100+250+200+120+120 = 830 px` in `apps/finance/view/GridContainer.mjs:23-55`) leave `562 px` blank dead space inside a `1,392 px` grid at `1440 × 900`, the toolbar holds only two bare `Start`/`Stop` buttons with inline styles, `ViewportController#updateRecord()` (`:66`) indexes `0..100` unguarded against filtered store counts, `GridContainer.mjs:5` JSDoc says `@extends Neo.table.Container`, and there is no CSS/search filter.
- **`apps/email` is missing from `examples.json`, opens empty on the right half, and overflows at `390 × 844`:** `WorkspaceContainer.mjs:40` initializes `email: null` without selecting row `0` in `WorkspaceController.mjs:21-28`, leaving the detail reader showing `"Select an email to read"` and `"Open in window"` disabled on arrival; at `390 × 844`, `.email-main-view` (`min-width: 440px`) + `.email-detail-panel` (`min-width: 300px`) force `740 px` horizontally.
- **Catalog hygiene (`examples.json`, `apps/portal/llms.txt`, `apps/covid/Util.mjs`):** `realworld` and `realworld-v2` (with literal `</br>(in progress)` in its name) remain as `hiddenIn`-all-4-mode records; `webdesktop` still lists `"component": "State Provider"` after `#21305` / `#21310` moved its shell to `src/desktop`; `covid-dashboard` omits `#mainview=table` on `urls.devmode`, and `Covid.Util.getCountryFlagUrl()` requests a bare directory URL on empty country names (`ERR_BLOCKED_BY_ORB`).
- **`captureExamples.mjs` blocks families containing external `https://` records:** `validateCaptureRecipes` (`line 127`) requires every covered catalog record in a declared family to have a capture recipe, while `capture()` (`line 253`) refuses external `https://` `devmode` URLs such as `devindex` (`https://neomjs.com/devindex/`).

## The Architectural Reality

- `Portal.model.Example.publishes()` and `buildScripts/docs/seo/seoJson.mjs` publish a catalog entry when `record.image` is present and the active mode URL is not in `hiddenIn`.
- `buildScripts/docs/captureExamples.mjs` validates `apps/portal/resources/data/example-captures.json` against `apps/portal/resources/data/examples.json`, executes deterministic public-DOM steps, and writes `1280 × 720` (`640 × 360 @ 2×` DPR, `< 150 KB`) JPEGs served from `neomjs/pages` `resources_pub/website/examples/devmode/`.
- `Email.view.WorkspaceContainer` (`Neo.dashboard.Container`) + `Email.view.MainView` (`defineComponent`) are covered by `test/playwright/e2e/realworld/EmailMultiWindowNL.spec.mjs`; `test/playwright/unit/apps/realworld/Api{Errors,Token}.spec.mjs` load `apps/realworld*` directly, so the `apps/realworld*` folders must stay on disk while their catalog entries leave.
- `Finance.store.Companies` + `Finance.view.Viewport` follow `apps/` authoring rules (`Neo.state.Provider` + `Neo.data.Store` + CSS under `resources/css/src/apps/finance/`).

## The Fix

1. **`apps/finance` + `resources/css/src/apps/finance/Viewport.css` + `test/playwright/unit/apps/finance/ViewportController.spec.mjs`:**
   - Flex `Company` & `Sector` columns and add `Change %` and `Volume` columns so the grid fills `1440 × 900` cleanly.
   - Add `changePercent` and `volume` fields on `Finance.model.Company`, deterministic initial quote seeding, filter-safe `updateRecord()` + `destroy()` interval cleanup on `ViewportController`, a filterable `Companies` store (`SearchFilter` / `Filter`), `ViewportStateProvider` reactive counts/status, and a wrapping responsive CSS-styled search + ticker status toolbar in `Viewport.mjs` (`docW <= 390` at `390 × 844`).
2. **`apps/email` + `resources/css/src/apps/email/{MainView,WorkspaceContainer}.css` + `test/playwright/e2e/realworld/EmailMultiWindowNL.spec.mjs`:**
   - Select record `0` on initial inbox construction/load in `WorkspaceController#selectInitialEmail()` so `DetailView` opens populated (`Project conversation 1`, `"Open in window"` active), while updating `EmailMultiWindowNL.spec.mjs` test 1 to verify initial selection and then toggle row `0` off via click to exercise the unselected empty-reader + `openInWindow('detail') === false` guard.
   - Add `@media (max-width: 767px)` column stacking (`.neo-flex-container.neo-flex-direction-row`, `52%` clipped inbox above `48%` detail reader) so `docW <= 390` at `390 × 844`.
3. **`apps/covid/{Util,view/country/Table}.mjs`:**
   - Guard empty/non-string country names in `Covid.Util.getCountryFlagUrl()` (`return null`) and omit the `<img>` in `Country.Table` when `null`.
4. **Catalog, captures & SEO (`examples.json`, `example-captures.json`, `buildScripts/docs/captureExamples.mjs`, `CaptureExamples.spec.mjs`, `apps/portal/llms.txt`, `seo.json`, `MainContainerController.spec.mjs`, `ExamplesCatalogNL.spec.mjs` + companion `neomjs/pages` PR):**
   - Retire `realworld` and `realworld-v2` from `examples.json` and `llms.txt`; update `webdesktop` `component` → `"Desktop"` and `covid-dashboard` `urls.devmode` → `"apps/covid/index.html#mainview=table"`.
   - Exempt external-origin (`http(s)://`) covered records in `validateCaptureRecipes` while enforcing same-origin covered records (`CaptureExamples.spec.mjs`), add `finance` (`family: 'apps'`) and `email` (`family: 'apps'`, `alsoIn: ['multi-window', 'functional']`) records + `"apps"` recipes for all 5 local apps (`webdesktop`, `covid-dashboard`, `portal`, `finance`, `email`) in `example-captures.json`, capture all 5 covers, deliver `devmode/finance-14.jpg` and `devmode/email-14.jpg` via a companion `neomjs/pages` PR, and regenerate `seo.json` + `class-hierarchy.json` + Portal count assertions.

Decision Record impact: none.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `apps/finance` fills a `1440 × 900` frame without dead right-hand blank space (flex `Company` & `Sector` columns plus `Change %` and `Volume`), seeds deterministic initial quotes on load, filters by symbol/company/sector through `ViewportStateProvider` + `Companies` store without `updateRecord()` out-of-bounds errors, cleans up its interval on `destroy()`, and fits `390 × 844` without document horizontal overflow (`docW <= 390`).
- [ ] `apps/email` selects the first inbox message on initial load so the detail pane opens populated (`Project conversation 1`, `"Open in window"` enabled), stacks cleanly below `768 px` (`docW <= 390` at `390 × 844`), and keeps `EmailMultiWindowNL.spec.mjs` green (including the deselected empty-reader + `openInWindow('detail') === false` guard and two native popup returns).
- [ ] `apps/portal/resources/data/examples.json` removes `realworld` and `realworld-v2` (and `apps/portal/llms.txt` updates accordingly while keeping `apps/realworld*` folders for their unit specs), updates `webdesktop` `component` to `"Desktop"` and `covid-dashboard` `urls.devmode` to `"apps/covid/index.html#mainview=table"` (with null-safe `Covid.Util.getCountryFlagUrl`), and publishes `finance` (`family: 'apps'`) and `email` (`family: 'apps'`, `alsoIn: ['multi-window', 'functional']`) with dark covers (`devmode/finance-14.jpg`, `devmode/email-14.jpg`).
- [ ] `buildScripts/docs/captureExamples.mjs` exempts external-origin (`http(s)://`) covered records (`devindex`) from local family recipe completeness while keeping same-origin covered records enforced (`CaptureExamples.spec.mjs`), and `apps/portal/resources/data/example-captures.json` declares `"apps"` with all 5 local `apps` recipes (`webdesktop`, `covid-dashboard`, `portal`, `finance`, `email`); `node buildScripts/docs/captureExamples.mjs --family apps` produces `1280 × 720` JPEGs (`< 150 KB`) with `devmode/finance-14.jpg` and `devmode/email-14.jpg` delivered in a companion `neomjs/pages` PR with matching `sha256` checksums.
- [ ] `seo.json` (`node buildScripts/docs/seo/generate.mjs -f seo-json` + `verify.mjs`), `docs/output/class-hierarchy.json`, `MainContainerController.spec.mjs`, `CaptureExamples.spec.mjs`, `Finance` unit spec, and `ExamplesCatalogNL.spec.mjs` pass with 0 baseline guard failures.
- [ ] PR body includes `1440 × 900` and `390 × 844` before/after frames for `apps/finance` and `apps/email` plus an unlabelled `## Cold look` evaluation.

## Out of Scope

- Cross-listed sibling apps owned by Multi-Window (`workstation`, `shared-covid`, `shareddialog`, `colors`) and Forms (`form-app`), which stay in Mnemosyne's and Ada's lanes.
- Replacing `WebDesktop`'s `AppView` placeholders with live component windows (deferred to Grace's `#21198` leaf per `MESSAGE:ce6dc1dc`).
- Removing `apps/realworld/` or `apps/realworld2/` source directories on disk (specs still test them) or removing legacy light-only test fixtures (`apps/legit`, `apps/route`, `apps/ai/neural-link`).
- Portal shell (`#21325` / `#21347`) or find field (`#21326`) layout changes.

## Avoided Traps

- Leaving `EmailMultiWindowNL.spec.mjs` asserting an empty detail reader before row click without adapting test 1 to click row 0 off first to verify the deselected guard.
- Using `clearInterval` without an interval-safe `updateRecord()` bounds check when filtering `Companies` reduces `store.getCount()` below `100`.
- Touching `ExamplesCatalogNL` / `MainContainer` layout owned by Julia's `#21325` (`#21347`) `Shell` PR.
